name: EmbodiedGovBench
summary: Evaluates runtime governability, comprising unauthorised capability use, runtime drift, recovery, upgrade safety, responsiveness to human override and auditability.
numbers: 7 governance dimensions; single-robot and fleet; 125 AI2-THOR instances

why.cog: Tests the runtime, not a model's reasoning.
why.xr: Override responsiveness and capability boundaries are loss-of-control precursors, tested as engineering faults rather than model propensity.
